_comment: Reference concerns registry — project-level preset config (engine: src/core/concerns.mjs; presets never enter core). Flavor artifactKinds map THIS project's generator vocabulary (the union of the reference generators' manifest.artifactKinds); the concern names and the schema-category axes mirror the production registry (backend-codegen truth/metarch/governance/concerns.json, E5-WP1 2026-09-12). The production event-journal-suite flavor (proto/converter/event-adapter/snapshot-adapter) has no protocol-buffer face in truthsrc — its event-payload chain here is protocol + entity + event-handler. materialized-read-model is absent: this project has no projection face yet.
